route_id.description: Operational route or voyage corridor identifier.

period.description: Reporting period or month label used in the source dataset.

distance.description: Distance covered during the reporting period.

fuel_type.description: Fuel type used during the period.

co2_emissions.description: CO2 emissions emitted during the period.

weather_condition.description: Observed weather condition for the voyage or period.

engine_efficiency.description: Engine efficiency percentage reported by the source.

cargo_capacity.description: Maximum cargo capacity of the vessel.

cargo_load.description: Cargo mass or payload loaded during the reporting period.

wind_speed.description: Wind speed at the operating period.

wave_height.description: Wave height at the operating period.

current_speed.description: Ocean current speed at the operating period.
